description: Pakistan Telecommunication Company Limited (PTCL) describes itself as the leading information and communication technology service provider in the region, and states that its telephony network is the backbone of the business. It provides fixed-line telephone, broadband internet and television services to homes and businesses, alongside managed network, hosted PBX and security solutions for corporate customers. PTCL is the parent of the mobile operator Ufone (Pak Telecom Mobile Limited), which it describes as a wholly-owned subsidiary; the company's own account records that Etisalat assumed management control of PTCL in 2006 under a deal to buy a 26% stake.
